Farmers National Bank decreased its stake in Unilever Plc Adr (UL) by 17.16% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Farmers National Bank sold 16,378 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.14% with the market. The institutional investor held 79,042 shares of the package goods and cosmetics company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.37M, down from 95,420 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Farmers National Bank who had been investing in Unilever Plc Adr for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $153.11B market cap company. The stock increased 0.90% or $0.5 $55.77. About 823,521 shares traded. Unilever PLC (NYSE:UL) has risen 5.35% uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.20% the S&P500.
